acceptanceCriteria: Locale-specific static routes /en/, /ja/, /zh-CN/ are generated via generateStaticParams and work under the GitHub Pages basePath; root / detects browser language with an explicit fallback to en (browser detection is not the only mechanism -- every locale has a stable shareable URL).

src/i18n/{locales,types,en,ja,zh-CN,getMessages}.ts implements one shared ExplorerMessages interface per locale; a missing/empty required key fails TypeScript or a test rather than silently falling back; internal semantic IDs (repository, runtime, contract, evidence, verification, outcome, humanAuthority, green/yellow/red/unknown/pending) are never translated, only their rendered copy.

Every comprehension surface is fully translated in all three locales: page title/subtitle, architecture labels and WHAT/INPUTS/OUTPUTS/BOUNDARY explanations, the 7-scene guided tour narration, lifecycle step descriptions, verification explanations including the literal 'Verified != Approved' / 検証済み ≠ 承認済み / 已验证 ≠ 已批准 distinction, human authority explanations, status/fail-closed copy, detail panel, help/interaction hints, and accessibility labels where practical.

A visible top-right language selector (EN / 日本語 / 中文, not hidden in a settings menu) switches language while preserving current mode, selected architecture object, and tour step where practical, and updates both the URL and visible text immediately.
html lang attribute and page metadata are correct and localized per locale (not hardcoded to en for every locale).

Tests cover: all three locales exist with identical key structure and no empty required key, language switching preserves semantic selection, locale URL generation is correct, an unsupported locale falls back safely; e2e coverage confirms English/Japanese/Chinese copy is visible under /en//ja//zh-CN/ respectively and the Verified!=Approved distinction renders correctly in each locale.

Blender/GLB is absent from README, docs, design-system docs, UI copy, and forward-looking implementation comments; no Blender dependency is added; historical .ai/work-items/archive/** contracts/evidence/decisions are left byte-for-byte untouched.

npm ci, lint, typecheck, unit tests, Playwright e2e, and the static export build all succeed; GitHub Pages deployment succeeds; the existing Governance Loop default screen, three navigation modes, and upstream provenance boundary to xinglun/ai-cockpit remain intact.
goal: Ship v0.2.1: /ai-cockpit-explorer/{en,ja,zh-CN}/ static routes via generateStaticParams, a typed src/i18n/ message architecture (no heavy i18n framework), full translation of the entire comprehension experience (title/subtitle/architecture labels+explanations/guided tour/lifecycle/verification incl. 'Verified != Approved'/detail panel/hints/a11y labels), a visible top-right language selector that preserves mode/selection/tour-step and updates the URL, correct html lang + localized metadata per locale, and locale-completeness + per-locale e2e tests. Confirm (do not rewrite) that Blender/GLB is absent from README/docs/design-system/UI copy/comments; historical .ai/work-items/archive contracts remain untouched.
intent: Confirm Blender is absent from current product/design documentation (historical .ai/work-items/archive records are governance history and must not be rewritten), and add first-class multilingual support (en/ja/zh-CN) with locale-specific static URLs to the Explorer, without regressing the v0.2 Governance Loop information architecture.
outOfScope: Changing the Governance Loop information architecture established in WI-002
